newsitem.title: UK: TC Group makes profit warning.
newsitem.headline: TC Group makes profit warning.

text.p: British nursing home operator TC Group said on Wednesday that results for the year ended December 31, 1996 would be modestly below market expectations.
It said in a statement the shortfall had arisen during the final quarter of 1996 as a result of lower rates of fill in recently opened and recently acquired care homes.
TC said that in the absence of further strategic initiatives, and if prevailing market conditions were to continue during 1997, growth in profit before tax would be reasonable.
However, the rate of profit growth would not match current market expectations if the lower rates of fill in recently opened and acquired homes continued.
